goals: Maintain 12 standard structural sets mirroring T1-T4 51-member count
Preserve two approved prior rare tank sets unchanged
Propose one rare physical damage set and one rare support set
Add nine exact class weapon plus four offhand candidates while preserving T1-T4 grip profiles
Support independent high-tier professions, wood/material sinks and sourced tradeable combat requirements

combatRules: All physical subtype weights are review metadata, not extra damage or an item affix
No automatic Slash/Pierce/Blunt proc, Bleed, Stagger, Armor Break, resistance, generic penetration or vulnerability
No effect triggered by DoT, reflect, proc chains, self-damage, duplicate simultaneous ticks, failed or absorbed-only hits unless specifically authorized
Stat channels use authored flat base profiles; new standard set members have no fixed innate percentage stats
New rare authored innate percentage stat per member is deterministic and not rarity-scaled twice
Do not introduce new physical affixes into existing pinned 13-affix pipeline
All effects must be server-owned and deterministic across offline/Q-mode/reconnect without phantom party auras
marketRules: Legacy equipment stays permanently ineligible for Player Market 2.0
Only authenticated newly minted and custodied EQ2 items may ever list, resell or be bought after separate launch approval
Profession crafting cannot require combat character level; wear can
Rare components and blueprints must be tradeable or obtainable by commission, independent of own combat level
releaseGates: Owner visual review for all new Style 4 art and actual UI/themes before app implementation
Reserve exact identities and reconcile with 169 original pinned plus 204 proposed T1–T4 plus 10 existing T5 source records, never merge accidental duplicates
Register all new material sources with actual enemy/gathering grants and payout telemetry, including Frostwood specialist throughput
Approve numeric base stat budgets, set-specific trigger semantics, overlapping caps, class/spec eligibility and new rare innates
Enforce original fixed rare Citadel/Bloodsteel innates and set bonuses byte-for-byte unchanged
Approve future T5 rarity/quality/13-affix compatibility, recipes and XP/Gold/time with observable economy impact
Implement authenticated PG custody, escrow, commissions, 2-route server reservations, rollback, duplicate protection and protected market provenance
Prove distinct weapon source + physical subtype handling for all nine classes and skill overrides; no automatic shield bash
Run nine-class/eighteen-spec/role counterplay replays and signed source tests across T4 and T5 plus dungeons/bosses
Obtain coordinated Veldryn 2.0 release approval; DO NOT merge this review, deploy, change runtime or reveal in live market
